description: Read a site's robots.txt and say whether a crawler may fetch a URL and by which rule, which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others) are let in or shut out, and what the sitemap holds. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Site checks: Fast checks on any site without a browser: HTTP headers with a security grade and the redirect chain, TLS certificate and expiry, DNS records with mail setup (SPF, DMARC), what a site is built with and its contacts, robots.txt and AI crawler access, and a crawl that finds broken links and builds a sitemap..

sitemap.description: Also read the sitemap and count its pages.

url.description: Any page of the site; its path is the one tested.

userAgent.description: Crawler name to test, for example GPTBot or Googlebot.

name: net_tools_robots
